description:
Humpty Dumpty Rhyme! — Humpty Dumpty sat on a wall, Humpty Dumpty had a great fall! Did you know an eggshell is as strong as an architectural dome?
Kids science answer for "humpty dumpty rhyme for kids" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

An egg's dome arch shape spreads weight evenly around the whole shell so mother birds do not crush them when sitting, but sharp drops crack the brittle calcium instantly.
